customerService:
Please read all auction description information and review photos before contacting us. Customer Service hours are 8:30 am to 4:30 pm CT Mon. through Fri. If you have any questions or concerns about an auction or shipping, please contact us via the Customer Service messaging system or call us at 555-555-0138. Please note that we prefer contact through the messaging system.


Below are answers to commonly asked questions. If you have questions regarding how the auction system records bids or the proxy bidding process, please contact website administration at user@example.test.

-----

Always check auction photos for details, as they're part of our listings. We are unable to GRADE or DESCRIBE defects that might be pre-existing and unknown to us since all items are donated and we don't know their history. Most items are free of foul odors unless otherwise stated.

-----

Ask questions BEFORE bidding and don't assume anything. REVIEW PICTURES CAREFULLY before placing a bid.

-----

Regarding precious metals and gemstones: we do our best to accurately test and describe these items; note that we use a Presidium gem tester which cannot distinguish between natural and lab-created gemstones. Large jewelry grab bags ship in bulk form and individual items are not wrapped; these lots may include broken and partial items--returns are not accepted.

-----

Sales tax is automatically applied by shopgoodwill.com and cannot be removed or reduced. If you feel you qualify for sales tax exemption you must request shopgoodwill.com to approve and apply it to your account. We cannot do that for you and will not remove sales tax from any order. Contact user@example.test for more information.

-----

We do not cancel bids on closed auctions.
missionStatement:
Goodwill of O is a community-based not-for-profit organization whose mission is to create opportunities for individuals with barriers to enhance their lives.


Your purchases help fund our mission in finding jobs for people facing disabilities and other barriers to employment. Why purchase from ShopGoodwill rather than other E-Commerce sites? Revenue generated from your purchases supports the many programs Goodwill offers within the communities they serve, including helping individuals find quality work, complete education goals, and more. The power of work is something we truly believe in and the success stories speak for themselves. Thank you for supporting our mission!
returnPolicy:
All items sell AS IS and all sales are considered final. Returns will only be accepted with prior authorization and under the terms stated in this Return Policy. Items may be returned within seven (7) days of receipt if the merchandise was damaged during shipping or if there was a major error in a listing or important details were omitted. All requests related to shipping damage require clear photos of the item and all packaging be submitted to us before the case will be reviewed. Photos must show any and all damage to item(s) purchased and packaging/boxes.


Returns and refunds are reviewed on an individual item basis and may be refused if they fall outside the details of this policy.


Large costume jewelry grabbags sell as is, ship in bulk, and are not eligible for refunds or returns.


Returns will not be accepted without prior authorization. Unauthorized returns will be considered a donation and no refund given.


PLEASE NOTE THAT WE REFUND SHIPPING AND HANDLING CHARGES AT OUR DISCRETION.


Items selected for pick up from the seller must be picked up within fourteen (14) days from close of auction. Items not picked up from seller within fourteen (14) days will be resold with no further notice.


Thank you for shopping with us!

Goodwill of O
